en:
Y'know, if I did die, my funeral would be way
more awesome than that shitty memory!

The whole country...no, the whole world
would mourn my passing!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Miu?

You wanna lose your virginity before you
die!?

Hah-haha! Too bad! It's gonna take more
than what you're packin' to satisfy me!

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
